question: The Nobel Prize in Literature 2020 was awarded to ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Louise Gluck.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Louise Glück was awarded the Nobel prize in Literature.​

 
 
• She won Nobel Prize in Literature 2020 for "her unmistakable poetic voice that with austere beauty makes individual existence universal".
